question: What would come in (2)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the importance of aligning career choices with personal values and interests.
 
• Ignoring one's true interests while pursuing financial stability can result in negative consequences over time.
 
• The word **burnout** refers to a state of emotional, physical, and mental exhaustion caused by excessive and prolonged stress. (थकावट / मानसिक तनाव)
 
 
• **Example:** Working long hours without rest can lead to burnout among employees.
 
 
 
• Other options like **success**, **freedom**, or **boredom** do not appropriately capture the long-term negative effect mentioned in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Success (सफलता) – Positive outcome; opposite of the intended negative consequence.
 
• **Option 3:** Freedom (स्वतंत्रता) – Not relevant in the context of long-term career dissatisfaction.
 
• **Option 4:** Boredom (उदासी / बोरियत) – Mild dissatisfaction; does not capture the intensity of long-term stress or exhaustion implied in the passage.
